verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud advertises AI capabilities, Grafana Assistant and Investigations, and its knowledge graph claims to generate insights about issues. It also ships incident management where responders work from the metrics, logs, and traces that fired the alert. However, no evidence explicitly says the AI summarizes incidents or alert context for responders, so the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated incident and alert summaries, details of how summaries reach responders (e.g. in incident timelines or notifications), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
